description: Searches concerts, sports, theater, comedy and other live events in a city from a start date, from Ticketmaster and Bandsintown, with an optional end date, category (music, sports, arts, theater, family, comedy) and keyword such as an artist, team or show. Results include venue, date and time, price range and, where the source gives one, a link to the event page. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone.

airport.description: Optional three-letter IATA code of the airport the person flies into, when known. Only used to tell same-named cities apart.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the city (for example FR), when known. Tells same-named cities apart.

place.description: The exact place of this trip stop: the `place` an earlier search for the trip returned, or the candidate the person picked when a search asked which place they meant. Searches given the same place cover the same place.

airports.description: IATA codes of the airports serving the place.

arrival_airports.description: The airports to fly this place by, best first, as a search returned them. Pass them back unchanged.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (territories use their own, e.g. PR).

extent_km.description: The size of a region or island, as a search returned it.

gateway_airport.description: The one airport a wide search flies this place by, as a search returned it.

kind.description: What the place is, as a search returned it. Pass it back unchanged: a town, region or island has its hotels searched around it.

label.description: How to name the place to the person, e.g. 'Birmingham, GB'.

radius_km.description: The hotel search radius for this place, as a search returned it.

name: search_events
